svg.aria-label: A leaf section from top to bottom: a thin cuticle, a row of upper epidermis cells, tall palisade cells with green chloroplasts, loosely packed spongy cells with gaps, and a lower epidermis with a pore between two guard cells; a vein in the middle with xylem above and phloem below.

g.title: cuticle: A waxy layer that reduces water loss.
upper epidermis: Transparent, so light passes through to the mesophyll.
palisade mesophyll: Tightly packed columnar cells with many chloroplasts: most photosynthesis.
spongy mesophyll: Loosely packed cells with air spaces for gas diffusion.
guard cell: A pair of cells round each stoma: they take up K⁺, water follows by osmosis, and they become turgid and open the pore.
stoma: A pore for CO₂ in and O₂ and water vapour out.
xylem: In the vein, on the upper side of the leaf.
phloem: In the vein, on the lower side.
